caseResults.title: Cases we've won for families like yours.
caseResults.disclaimer: These results are illustrative. Every case depends on its own facts. Past results do not guarantee future outcomes.

r1.headline: Asylum granted after 2 years in proceedings
r1.desc: Client fled persecution in Venezuela. We built a detailed declaration, secured expert country-conditions testimony, and the judge granted asylum at the merits hearing.

r2.headline: Detained Honduran client released on bond
r2.desc: Client was detained at Krome. We filed the bond motion within 48 hours, assembled a sponsorship package with tax returns and community letters, and secured release at the first hearing.

r3.headline: 15-year U.S. resident protected from removal
r3.desc: After 15 years in the United States with three U.S. citizen children, the immigration judge granted cancellation of removal based on exceptional and extremely unusual hardship.
